programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Carter Oosterhouse travels to Central, LA; Buffalo, NY; Ft. Lauderdale, FL; & Stamford, CT to judge whose house has the most impressive Christmas display. The families up to win $50,000 are The Hohensee’s, Field’s, Messingschlager’s, and Pampena’s.

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
programme.desc: Featured displays include a wireless light show, an interactive gingerbread house, fun figurines and giant lollipops, and a large property with 78 wrapped trees..

programme.title: The Great Christmas Light Fight
